//: 🤖 Screenshots for the homepage apps carousel (src/_includes/home-body.njk, src/home/apps.js). Each is the app's public landing page, captured with headless Chromium at a 1280x800 light viewport, saved 360 and 720 pixels wide (360x225, and 720x450 for sharp 2x screens) as AVIF, WebP and a JPEG fallback (<app>-360.*, <app>-720.*). Names, descriptions, logos and links come from the Apps page (src/apps/index.html): `app` is the Apps page name, lowercased, and `url` must be the Apps page's own link, or the build fails. `gallery` is the explicit exception: a name or url the carousel shows instead, each with the reason; an override that matches the Apps page is stale and also fails the build. `logoSpells` is the text a wordmark logo already spells: that part of the name is shown by the logo alone (and stays the logo's alt text), so it is not printed twice. Listed in the Apps page order.
